claims.label: INDEPENDENTLY_ACCEPTED_AT_DECLARED_SCOPE
claims.exact_statement: For every finite list of genuine Boolean one-point defects q_(n_j) on pairwise disjoint uniform physical blocks and every deterministic factor-first exhaustive order, each complete L+Q stage has positive reach-weighted credit P_j<48*2^(-n_j)<=24 I(q_(n_j)), and sum_j P_j<24 I(product_j q_(n_j)). Combined with the separately accepted multifactor ownership identity, R(A)+sum_j N_j=sum_j P_j<24 I(product).
does_not_prove: a payment for addressing or unrelated branches
claims.first_unproved_line: Construct a distribution-valued or operator-valued secant-variation payment for unrelated Boolean branches or shared physical variables that survives addressing and has a single-use influence/KL budget.
